Israel Defence Minister announces indefinite troop presence in Lebanon, Syria, Gaza

Israel's Defence Minister has stated that Israeli troops will remain indefinitely in security zones established in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza. This announcement comes amidst ongoing conflict and reports of Israeli strikes in Gaza, including one that killed two people and set tents ablaze. While one report mentions a U.S.-sponsored peace framework agreement between Israel and Lebanon, other coverage highlights Palestinian resistance and casualties.
